rule: v1 remains frozen and is scored alongside; v2 is the operational ranking from 25 Nov 2026; any v3 must beat v2 on identical races

candidate_record.candidate: Combined national candidate (NOT LIVE, shadow only)
components: distance-specific suitability REPLACING the distance record in layers 1-2 (kernel h = 0.12 on log distance, k = 3; preregistered Batch 26-27)
handicap weight slope wt_x_hcp (third layer; preregistered Batch 12)
trainer debut record tr_debut_g and sire debut record sire_debut_x (third layer; genuine debutants aged 2-3 only)
candidate_record.built_from: the national release chain in a sandbox copy of the Engine v2.5 build (/tmp/cc): consolidated frame with the distance slot replaced (batch27/b27_dspec.py) -> freeze_b5_national_common.py with DREC_SOURCE=dspec -> engine/release_v2.py -> batch28/b28_build_combined.py (third layer; debut terms from batch28/b28_debut_terms.py)
candidate_record.approved: Damo 28 Nov 2026 (Batch 28 s3 and amendment): build the combined national candidate through the release chain and start the shadow once dependencies are satisfied; promotion a separate decision

serving.distance: prerace/score_national_prerace.py when d_rec_source = dspec (serving vs offline max diff 3e-5, 28 Nov, 695 runners)
serving.trainer_debut: engine/v22.py trainer_debut (parity with historical values exact on 6 sample dates)
serving.sire_debut: engine/v22.py sire_debut: sire from TAB's pre-race form record (as held at production scoring), else the pedigree held; parity exact on 6 sample dates
serving.handicap: engine/v22.py wt_x_hcp from TAB's race class field (BMnn -> Benchmark)

candidate_record.open_dependency: class parity (TAB race class at scoring vs the historical class label) is checked on Monday's master refresh BEFORE any release decision; the shadow runs meanwhile
caveats: 2025-26 has been examined repeatedly in research; the built check confirms the harness rather than giving a fresh test
window 2024 is not a clean test of the layer-1/2 change (their dev fit includes 2024)
Queensland not in scope (national family only)
